title: Portable named directory scopes
summary: Names such as inboundfiles and dependencies are mapped to host-local directory sets; search is bounded and candidates carry times, full paths, sizes, SHA-256 status and match reasons.
invariants: Unknown scopes do not fall back to HOME, all mounts or an invented path.
Archive member discovery does not extract ZIPs.
A filename, newest mtime or archive digest is not a release-authenticity claim.
